description: This Java source file defines the MongoReadJournal class, which interacts with MongoDB to read event journals and snapshots within an Akka persistent system. The class provides methods to retrieve persistence IDs, latest snapshots, and configure connections based on Akka system configuration, specifically for the Eclipse Ditto project and akka-persistence-mongo plugin integration.

classes.name: MongoReadJournal
classes.description: Provides methods to interact with MongoDB for reading event journals and snapshots in an Akka persistent environment, including creation from system config or specific collection names.

classes.name: SnapshotBatch
classes.description: A helper class representing a batch of snapshot documents with the maximum PID.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates new instances of MongoReadJournal either from ActorSystem or explicit collection names and Mongo client.

methods.name: getJournalPids
methods.description: Streams all unique PIDs from the journal collection, with batch size and idle time controls.

methods.name: getJournalPidsAbove
methods.description: Streams unique PIDs from the journal collection above a specified lower bound.

methods.name: getNewestSnapshotsAbove
methods.description: Streams the newest snapshots with PIDs above a certain lower bound, optionally projecting specific fields.
